coordinator_error.message: Phase sub-agent persisted the structured implementation-review handoff locally for orchestrator pickup.

payload.summary: Implementation review did not converge. The escalated multi-vendor run produced findings from Codex and Grok; Antigravity timed out, Claude had unresolved model routing, and Pi exhausted invalid-output recovery. Contract validation then proved the Codex payload ineligible because it contains an invalid axis value, leaving only one schema-valid vendor and therefore no true two-vendor quorum. This live failure confirms the review dispatcher's schema-validation defect. Independent source inspection confirms multiple additional merge-blocking contract gaps, including missing default reviewer routing, missing replacement-vendor scheduling, weak transitive consensus grouping, absent consensus relational validation, incomplete adjudication-ledger support, and incomplete manifest attempt provenance.
completed_work: Dispatched the approved implementation diff and relevant OpenSpec artifacts to five configured vendor services under bounded per-vendor deadlines.
Collected parseable findings from Codex (9) and Grok (17); both independently identified several of the same safety-critical gaps.
Detected that the dispatcher incorrectly counted the contract-invalid Codex result as eligible; only Grok passed review-findings.schema.json, so true review quorum was lost.

Preserved the dispatcher's provisional consensus artifact for diagnosis; it reports 26 unique groups and 24 effective blockers but is not admissible as two-vendor consensus because one input was schema-invalid.
Produced a schema-valid multi-vendor synthesis at reviews/round-1/review-findings.json containing 13 source-verified critical findings.
Cross-checked the highest-severity findings against the implementation source and confirmed they are actionable rather than review hallucinations.
in_progress: Remediation is required before another implementation-review round can converge.

decisions.title: Return not_converged
decisions.rationale: True schema-valid vendor quorum was lost, and the parseable vendor evidence plus independent source inspection surfaced 13 merge-blocking defects.

decisions.title: Do not count failed vendor attempts toward quorum
decisions.rationale: Antigravity, Claude, and Pi did not produce attributable schema-valid terminal review results.

next_steps: Implement a real default reviewer-archetype resolver so review-mode callers use explicit > phase > reviewer default > static-on-resolution-failure precedence.
Implement bounded replacement-vendor allocation with slot transfer/cancellation and distinct-vendor quorum accounting.
Validate parsed review findings against the full findings schema and size/count limits before marking output schema_valid or entering quadratic matching.
Replace union-find transitive grouping with deterministic clique/anchor admission and structured type/location evidence.
Implement and invoke validate_consensus_report() before persistence and convergence decisions.
Load and validate the adjudication ledger, preserve per-finding concern fingerprints, and verify accepted-risk authorization through a trusted resolver.
Persist full logical attempt chains progressively and derive CLI-manifest quorum with the shared eligibility predicate.
Fix auth error-class normalization, post-invocation deadline enforcement, SDK thinking translation, and disagreement handling after valid adjudication.
After targeted fixes and focused verification, run IMPL_REVIEW again.
